inputs.prompt: This is an instrumental music bed of two minutes for a short film. Listen to all of it and answer each point plainly, with times in seconds where you can. 1. Describe what you hear in order: instruments, mood, and where the energy changes. 2. Is there any human voice anywhere: singing, choir, humming, vocal samples or spoken words? Give the times if so. 3. Is the tempo steady, and about how many beats per minute? 4. Are there audible edit points or faults: jumps, clicks, stutters, abrupt cuts, distortion, pumping? Give the times. 5. Does it sound like a modern premium technology advert, or cheesy and corporate, or aggressive? Say which and why. 6. How does it end, and does the ending sound finished?

expect.basis: live price read 2026-11-14: 0.01 USD per 5 seconds; the file is 120.5 s

note: a listening model's notes on bed.wav (music only is sent: no speech, no picture)
